quality.title: Your Tuesday just got delicious
quality.sharpenedBrief: Create one Instagram post that captures a relatable, joyful everyday cheesecake moment—a midweek treat, a friend hangout, a solo indulgence. Use direct address ('tú'), playful urgency, and sensory language that makes the moment feel both special and accessible. Include emoji and exclamation energy; no offers, no discounts, no invented products.

questions.q: Is this everyday moment solo indulgence, a friend share, or a small group gathering?
questions.solvingFor: Which relatable scenario anchors the caption and image selection.
questions.why: Brand Core JOTBD: 'Help me find a fun, delicious, and photo-worthy dessert to share with my friends' and 'Give me an easy and special way to celebrate a moment, big or small.'

questions.q: Which existing Cake Me cheesecake flavor or style will appear in the image?
questions.solvingFor: Authentic product reference and whether the visual emphasizes texture, topping, or the moment around it.
questions.why: Brand Core Positioning: 'artisanal cheesecakes that transform everyday moments' requires real product, not generic dessert.

questions.q: Should the tone lean toward 'treat yourself' self-care or 'bring people together' connection?
questions.solvingFor: Whether the caption prioritizes personal indulgence or shared joy, shaping the directness of the call to feel.
questions.why: Brand Core Pillars balance 'Joyful Indulgence' and 'Genuine Connection'—both authentic, but they shape voice register differently.

quality.title: Your Tuesday just got a whole lot sweeter
quality.sharpenedBrief: Create one Instagram post that captures a relatable, joyful everyday cheesecake moment—a friend group, a solo treat, a work-week break—using Cake Me's playful, direct voice and existing product references. Emphasize the happiness and shareability of the moment, not a sale. The caption should feel like a best friend's genuine excitement, with direct address and sensory language.

questions.q: Is this post anchored to a real, specific everyday moment (e.g., mid-week pick-me-up, friend hangout, solo celebration) or a seasonal/timeless vibe?
questions.solvingFor: Whether to shoot a styled scene or rely on authentic user-generated-style imagery, and what product variant to feature
questions.why: Brand Core says 'transform everyday moments into memorable, shareable celebrations of happiness'—so we need to lock which everyday moment this is

questions.q: Should the caption use 'tú' to address one person indulging solo, or 'nosotros' to invite a sense of community and sharing?
questions.solvingFor: Tone direction and whether the image shows solo enjoyment or a group moment
questions.why: Signatures state: 'Addressing the audience directly with tú and using nosotros to build a sense of community'—this choice shapes authenticity

questions.q: Which Cake Me product reference (flavor, size, or signature detail) should be visible or mentioned in the post?
questions.solvingFor: Specificity and product credibility without inventing offers
questions.why: Brand Core emphasizes 'Artisanal Quality' and 'Genuine Connection'—product specificity reinforces this, not generic 'cheesecake'

quality.title: Your Tuesday Just Got Sweeter
quality.sharpenedBrief: Create one Instagram post that captures a relatable, mid-week cheesecake moment—a friend group, a solo treat, or a quiet celebration—that feels genuinely joyful and shareable. Use direct address, sensory language, and Cake Me's signature emojis to invite followers into the happiness, not a sale. No offers; pure celebration of the experience.

questions.q: Is this post anchored to a specific everyday scenario (coffee break, friend meetup, solo indulgence) or intentionally universal?
questions.solvingFor: Choosing between a tight narrative moment (more relatable) or open invitation (broader reach)
questions.why: Brand Core: 'Give me an easy and special way to celebrate a moment, big or small'—we need to know if you're narrowing the moment or keeping it wide.

questions.q: Should the image show the cheesecake as the star, or the *people enjoying it* as the focus?
questions.solvingFor: Determining whether the post leads with product beauty or shared happiness
questions.why: Brand Core PILLAR 'Genuine Connection'—this shapes whether we're selling the slice or the feeling.
